text:
The Kraeford Compact’s twenty-two years ended in its destruction, a trajectory defined by internal instability and a fatal war with the Goummeidale Compact. The period began with the Compact allied to House Thream, but its leadership was fragile. Skur Stas held the seat until his murder by Kraedren Waeld in year 5. Waeld’s subsequent challenge to the named heir, Stearnke Gullleith, was rejected by election, and Waeld was cast out. Gullleith then ruled until his death in year 9, after which Frouldtoun Dror took the seat by election. The Compact’s authority was further eroded by a conspiracy from Thral Rei, who had returned from exile, leading to Rei’s execution in year 18.

The Compact’s military posture was largely unsuccessful. It sent five raids, four of which were beaten off and one that carried off plunder. It suffered three raids, all of which carried off plunder. Its standing collapsed during a war with the Goummeidale Compact, which it had broken in year 21. The Compact lost two battles, at Seithfaehollow in year 21 and at Kraeford in year 22. In the same years, it lost both Seithfaehollow and Kraeford to the Goummeidale Compact. The Compact was finished in year 22, its land seized and its followers scattered.

Internal decay accompanied the external defeats. Two famines killed 74 people across Seithfaehollow and Kraeford in years 14 and 15. The Compact’s final years saw a marriage binding it to House Thream in year 22, but this alliance could not prevent its end. The Goummeidale Compact and the Kraeford Compact made peace in year 23, after the Compact’s collapse. The period saw three people hold the seat, with rules ending in death, house termination, and murder. The Compact’s history was one of failed raids, lost battles, and ultimate dissolution.

The Goummeidale Compact’s twenty-year span from 2 to 21 was defined by a cycle of internal purges and external wars that eroded its authority while briefly expanding its territory. The period began with the Compact holding Ra Cut, a site it had occupied in year 2. It ended with Freindmald Beindlea holding the seat, having just defeated the Kraeford Compact in a war that began in year 21. Throughout the era, the Compact fought three battles, winning all of them, yet it suffered eight raids and saw two of its places rise against it. The standing of the Compact fell very low by year 13 and again by year 18, allowing Ra Cut and Sti Seam to revolt.

Sealoll Lael held the seat from the start until his death in year 12. His rule was marked by a conspiracy uncovered in year 5, which led to the casting out of Vinbeil Real. In year 5, the Compact declared war on House Thream for Sti Seam, breaking its alliance with them. The Compact defeated House Thream at Sti Seam in year 5, with 34 dead, and again in year 6, with 28 dead, taking Sti Seam from them. Peace was made in year 7 after two years of fighting. Sealoll Lael was murdered at Goummeidale in year 12 by Thral Rei. That same year, the Kraeford Compact raided Goummeidale, carrying off 34 grain and killing 55.

Fous Bo took the seat in year 12 by right of birth. His rule saw the uncovering of Thral Rei’s conspiracy in year 13, leading to Thral Rei’s casting out. Ra Cut rose against the Compact in year 13 due to its fallen standing. Fous Bo was murdered at Goummeidale in year 19 by Kraedren Waeld. During his rule, the Compact raided Kraeford in year 13, carrying off 40 grain and killing 28, and raided Seithfaehollow in year 16, carrying off 32 grain and killing 36. Sti Seam rose against the Compact in year 18 as its standing fell very low.

Kaell Frouspim took the seat in year 19 by right of birth. His rule was short, ending with his death at the hands of Frouldtoun Dror in year 21. In year 20, the Compact uncovered Kraedren Waeld’s conspiracy, leading to his casting out. The Compact declared war on the Kraeford Compact in year 21 over a long-standing grievance, breaking its alliance with them. It defeated the Kraeford Compact at Seithfaehollow in year 21, with 110 dead, and took Seithfaehollow from them.

Freindmald Beindlea took the seat in year 21 by right of birth, still holding it at the end of the period. The period saw four people hold the seat, with the seat passing three times. Three were killed, and one remained. The Compact fought two wars, spending two years at war. It sent two raids, both carrying off plunder, and suffered eight raids, seven of which were beaten off. Hunger and sickness killed 364 people and caused 502 to flee their homes across eleven years.

House Thream’s twenty-eight years ended in total destruction, a trajectory defined by a single, escalating conflict with the Goummeidale Compact. The period began with an alliance between the two powers, but that bond dissolved quickly into war. House Thream fought four battles against the Goummeidale Compact and lost all of them, losing two key settlements in the process. The house’s internal stability was equally fragile; six people held the seat in this period, with rules ending through death, murder, or the end of the house itself. The power that started with an alliance and a raiding capability finished landless, its followers scattered.

At the start, Freamteas Kraeth ruled House Thream until his death in year 3. His successor, Bran Nas, took the seat by the strongest claim. The alliance with the Goummeidale Compact, sealed by the marriage of Kokaes Threll to Thral Rei in year 3, broke in year 5 when the Compact declared war over a famine at Sti Seam. House Thream responded by raiding Seithfaehollow, carrying off 27 grain and killing 35 people. This raid was the only one that succeeded; the Goummeidale Compact defeated House Thream at Sti Seam in year 5 and again in year 6, taking Sti Seam from them. Bran Nas died in year 6, and Kokaes Threll took the seat by setting aside the claim of the named heir Ma Graltaeld, who was cast out.

Kokaes Threll’s rule was short. In year 8, Fous Bo had him murdered at Loufell. Vinbeil Real took the seat by the strongest claim. Fous Bo’s conspiracy against Vinbeil was uncovered in year 10, and Fous Bo was cast out. Vinbeil died in year 17, and Sen Tom took the seat. Sen Tom’s rule ended in year 26 when Maethhol Gondrur challenged him openly, won, and took the seat. Maethhol Gondrur killed Sen Tom at Loufell. The Goummeidale Compact declared war again in year 27 over a long-standing grievance. They defeated House Thream at Loufell in year 27 and again in year 28, taking Loufell from them. In year 28, House Thream was finished, its land taken and its last three followers scattering.

The Goummeidale Compact’s rule in these years was defined by Maethhol Gondrur’s survival against a succession of internal conspiracies and the collapse of its external authority. At the start, the power faced a demographic crisis at Seithfaehollow, where a plague broke out in year 42, killing 103 people. The same year, Seill Kreannae’s conspiracy against Maethhol Gondrur was uncovered after four years, leading to Kreannae’s expulsion from the Compact. The plague at Seithfaehollow continued into year 43, claiming 150 more lives and driving 171 others to flee.

Maethhol Gondrur remained in the seat through further internal threats. In year 46, Thaeld Faeth’s conspiracy against him was uncovered after three years, resulting in Faeth’s execution. The following year, Gu Veam’s attempt on Maethhol Gondrur’s life failed and was traced back, leading to Veam’s expulsion from the Compact. Despite these internal purges, the power’s standing deteriorated. In year 50, Gu Veam’s conspiracy against Maethhol Gondrur was uncovered after four years, and Veam was declared an outlaw despite having already left.

The period ended with the destruction of the Compact’s authority. In year 50, Skein Teththeald’s conspiracy against Maethhol Gondrur was uncovered after three years, and Teththeald was cast out. The Goummeidale Compact’s standing had fallen to nothing. In year 50, Sti Seam rose against the Compact, marking the end of its rule.

The Goummeidale Compact’s twenty-year span from 22 to 41 was defined by violent succession and the elimination of external rivals. The period began with the murder of Freindmald Beindlea by Waeld Dould, a act that triggered a cascade of internal purges and external conquests. The Compact emerged from the destruction of the Kraeford Compact and House Thream, taking their seats at Kraeford and Loufell. Yet its internal stability remained fragile, marked by six internal murders and five castings out. The era closed with Maethhol Gondrur holding the seat, having inherited it after the murder of Brethneld Draer, while a plague at Seithfaehollow claimed 106 lives.

The Compact’s early years were shaped by the collapse of its neighbors. In 22, it defeated the Kraeford Compact at Kraeford, killing 181 and taking the settlement, which finished the Kraeford Compact. It also defeated House Thream at Loufell in 27 and 28, killing 123 and 103 respectively, and took Loufell from them, finishing House Thream. These victories were accompanied by one raid on Loufell in 24 that took nothing, and three raids suffered that were all beaten off. The Compact declared war on House Thream in 27, a conflict that lasted three years.

Succession within the Compact was unstable. Frouldtoun Dror took the seat in 22 by right of birth but was cast out in 28 for an attempted murder. He was succeeded by Voumfaern Ki, who was cast out in 29 after losing an open challenge to Skullhein Threill. Skullhein was murdered in 30, leading to Theirnpae Gro taking the seat, who was himself killed in 31 by Rateal Fototh after a coup. Rateal was then cast out in 31 by Vasgou Raend, who died in 34. Wold Risla took the seat in 34 by right of birth, was cast out in 35 after losing an open challenge to Brethneld Draer, who was murdered in 40. Maethhol Gondrur took the seat in 40 by right of birth. Six people were courted away from its rulers during this time.

Maethhol Gondrur took the seat of the Goummeidale Compact in 40 after Seill Kreannae killed Brethneld Draer. The new ruler’s tenure began with a plague at Seithfaehollow that took 106 lives, followed by the uncovering of a conspiracy by Kreannae, who was cast out in 42. The pestilence burned out after one year, only to return in 42 with 103 dead. In 43, the plague at Seithfaehollow killed 150 more and drove 171 to flee before burning out after two years. During this time, Skein Teththeald and Thaeld Faeth were raised to steward, and Gu Veam was named heir.

Internal stability eroded as Thaeld Faeth won Fol Skeambol away from the ruler in 44, prompting the Compact to spend 185 silver to buy back goodwill in 46. Thaeld Faeth’s own conspiracy was uncovered in 46, and he was put to death. Gu Veam attempted to kill Maethhol Gondrur in 47 but failed; he was cast out in 47 and declared an outlaw in 50. Skein Teththeald married Grourn Kannous at Kraeford in 47 and Theldsild Tripould at Loufell in 48. He won Meind Veild away from the ruler in 50, and Meind Veild was raised to steward that same year. Skein Teththeald’s conspiracy was uncovered in 50, and he was cast out.

The Goummeidale Compact’s standing had fallen to nothing when Sti Seam rose against it in 50. Maethhol Gondrur’s rule ended in 51 with the period closing. During the reign, children were born to the ruler at Loufell: Hidol Krund in 40, Faethhund Fam in 45, Pan Dros in 47, and Fraethrul Fri in 51. Thra Meil and Theldsild Tripould married at Loufell in 48, and Tea Meir was born to them in 51.

In year 5, the Goummeidale Compact declared war on House Thream over the site of Sti Seam. The conflict began with a decisive engagement at that location, where the Goummeidale Compact defeated House Thream, leaving 34 dead. The fighting continued at Sti Seam in year 6, resulting in another defeat for House Thream and 28 dead. Following this second loss, the Goummeidale Compact took Sti Seam from House Thream.

The war lasted for two years. In year 7, the Goummeidale Compact and House Thream made peace. Both sides were exhausted by the end of the conflict.

The Goummeidale Compact declared war on the Kraeford Compact in 21 over a long-standing grievance. In that same year, the Goummeidale Compact defeated the Kraeford Compact at Seithfaehollow, where 110 people died, and took the settlement from the Kraeford Compact.

In 22, the Goummeidale Compact defeated the Kraeford Compact at Kraeford, where 181 people died, and took the settlement from the Kraeford Compact.

In 23, the Goummeidale Compact and the Kraeford Compact made peace after two years, following the collapse of the Kraeford Compact.
